reason: A is the better proposal because it specifies a composition-controlled series, baseline, phase constraints, multiple decisive superconductivity measurements, and literature-grounded falsification criteria. Its main weakness is that configurational entropy is only a compositional proxy and substitution can alter chemistry and phonons even at fixed electron count, but B is less controlled, conflates annealing with strain, provides no supporting evidence, and does not clearly isolate or quantify the proposed local-distortion mechanism.
